listings.title: BMW M5 E39 Saloon
listings.evidence: The current Car & Classic advert is explicitly For Sale at £50,000 and identifies this as a 2003 BMW E39 M5 saloon with 46,637 miles, six-speed manual transmission, registration KR52 ZTT and a UK dealer location in Surrey.
listings.photoEvidence: Exact current seller exterior and cabin photographs inspected on 13 September 2026. No SOLD, RESERVED, DEPOSIT TAKEN or UNDER OFFER overlay was visible; the cabin photograph clearly shows the manual gear lever and three pedals.
listings.notes: LHD and originally US supplied. The seller says the present owner bought it in 2006, brought it to the UK in 2009, had VANOS warranty work and a later clutch replacement, and stored the car from 2015. The seller also says an airbag recall may remain outstanding; verify recommissioning, recall completion and the full history before purchase.
listings.gavinSays: This is a different sort of E39 M5 pick: left-hand drive, but only 46,637 miles and with one long-term owner since 2006 according to the advert. I like the documented VANOS work, replacement clutch and the fact the proper six-speed cabin is visible in the photos. The long storage period and possible airbag recall need sorting, but the low mileage makes it worth the scrutiny.
listings.recheckEvidence: Actual Car & Classic advert rechecked on 13 September 2026 with live For Sale status, asking price, mileage and dealer location. Exact exterior and cabin seller photographs visually inspected; manual shifter and three pedals visible and no unavailable overlay observed.

listings.title: Porsche 996 Turbo S Cabriolet
listings.evidence: McMillan's current sales inventory and exact advert both show this 2004 996 Turbo S Cabriolet as For Sale at £67,995 with 19,822 miles and manual transmission.
listings.photoEvidence: Original dealer advert labels For Sale: 2004 Turbo S Cabriolet, manual, 19,822 miles. Four current-source exterior photographs inspected; no unavailable overlay.
listings.notes: Arena Red with extended grey leather, PCCB and very low mileage. Dealer states three previous owners and a history file running from the original sales invoice through to the latest service.
listings.gavinSays: A sub-20k-mile manual 996 Turbo S is exactly the sort of car I want on the site. The Cabriolet body style caps the collector ceiling versus a Coupé, but the mileage, Turbo S specification and history file make this one impossible to ignore at £67,995.

listings.title: Ferrari 456 GT
listings.evidence: Romans' exact vehicle page and current Ferrari inventory both show this 1996 Ferrari 456 GT at £59,995, 32,600 miles and six-speed manual with an active enquiry route.
listings.photoEvidence: The current vehicle page includes a seller photo gallery for the exact car and no sold, reserved or deposit-taken warning is displayed.
listings.notes: Rosso Monza over cream, three previous owners, gated V12 manual. The advert references the original toolkit, service book, leather wallet and extensive invoice history; verify the full chronology before purchase.
listings.gavinSays: This is a lot of analogue Ferrari for the money: front-engined V12, gated manual, four seats and £59,995. The 456 is not as liquid as a 550, but at this price the rarity and usability make it a serious value pick if the history is strong.

listings.title: Ferrari F355 Spider
listings.evidence: Forte Motors' current stock page and exact vehicle page show this 1996 F355 Spider at £89,999, 37,500 miles and six-speed manual transmission.
listings.photoEvidence: The exact current seller advert includes vehicle photographs and remains in the dealer's live used-car inventory with no sold, reserved or deposit-taken status shown.
listings.notes: Giallo Modena over black leather, four owners, imported by the current seller in 2016. Advertised with Speedline wheels, Tubi exhaust, sports catalysts/manifolds and a fresh timing-belt service to be completed; verify invoices and originality.
listings.gavinSays: A manual F355 in Giallo Modena has the theatre I want from this era. This one is not a concours-originality play because of the exhaust, catalysts and wheels, but at £89,999 it deserves a place on the shortlist if the service and import history stand up.

listings.title: Aston Martin V8 Vantage 4.7 Manual
listings.evidence: The current Car & Classic advert is explicitly For Sale at £32,500 and identifies this as a 2008 Aston Martin V8 Vantage 4.7-litre with 78,100 miles, six-speed manual transmission, registration NK58 ACU and a private seller in Surrey.
listings.photoEvidence: Nine current seller gallery photographs were inspected on 17 September 2026. No SOLD, RESERVED, DEPOSIT TAKEN or UNDER OFFER overlay was visible; multiple cabin photographs clearly show the conventional manual gear lever.
listings.notes: Facelift 4.7-litre manual in Grigio Titanio. The seller states the clutch was replaced around 2,000 miles ago, more than £14,000 was spent last year including brakes, steering rack and pump, servicing has been by Aston Martin main dealers, and the MOT runs to April 2027 with no advisories. Verify invoices before purchase.
listings.gavinSays: The 4.7 manual is the V8 Vantage specification I would rather own, and £32,500 puts this one in an interesting part of the market. The mileage is higher than a collector-grade car, but the recent clutch and substantial maintenance spend matter more for something intended to be driven. I would want the invoices to substantiate the work before going further.
listings.recheckEvidence: Actual Car & Classic advert rechecked on 17 September 2026 with live For Sale status, fixed £32,500 asking price, 78,100-mile reading and UK private-seller location. Nine seller photographs were visually inspected; the manual shifter is clearly visible and no unavailable overlay was observed.

listings.title: Aston Martin V8 Vantage N400 Roadster
listings.evidence: The current Auto Trader advert is live with private-seller contact controls and identifies this as a 2008 Aston Martin Vantage N400 Roadster at £39,500 with 29,000 miles and a manual gearbox in Oxted, Surrey. The seller states ownership since 2018, full service history, an August 2026 service and MOT to June 2027 with no advisories.
listings.photoEvidence: Five current seller vehicle photographs were inspected on 17 September 2026. No SOLD, RESERVED, DEPOSIT TAKEN or UNDER OFFER overlay was visible. The cabin photographs clearly show a conventional manual gear lever, and the centre armrest carries the N400 Nürburgring-map detailing.
listings.notes: Lightning Silver N400 Roadster, registration RK08 JJE. Auto Trader's derivative text is internally inconsistent on engine capacity, but the advert, N400 detailing and manual cabin are consistent with the qualifying N400 special edition. Verify the service invoices and build identity before purchase.
listings.gavinSays: This is much closer to the sort of V8 Vantage I want to keep: N400 specification, proper six-speed manual, only 29,000 advertised miles and long private ownership since 2018. The current photos show the manual shifter and N400 Nürburgring detailing. At £39,500 it is not cheap, but the rare specification, recent service and full-history claim justify a closer look before paying any premium.
